# Stonecutter

Type: Crafting | Skill: Crafting | Internal ID: piece_stonecutter | Source: Workbench | Usage: Build stone structures | Max Level: 1 | Crafting Materials: Wood x10, Iron x2, Stone x4 | Weak to (x1.5): Chop | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning | Resistant to (x0.5): Pierce | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Spirit

# Introduction

Stonecutters are base structures used for crafting Sharpening stones and building Stone structures, Black marble structures, Grausten structures and other stone based building elements.
Crafting requires a roof and 70% cover. Building structures does not require a roof or any cover.

### Building

• Hearth
• Paved road
• Stone throne
• Black marble bench
• Black marble table
• Black marble throne
• Bone throne

### Crafting

• Sharpening stone - used to make the Forge upgrade Grinding wheel

Categorias: Crafting structures, Crafting, Building
